integrity: Analytic counting proof and standalone exact enumerations of six examples; self-review only; no independent audit or external certification.
scientific_limitations: For uniform perfect matchings of complete graphs with edge sets partitioned into spanning regular color classes; third mixed cumulant only for three distinct colors; no higher-order or asymptotic assertion. Possible earlier implicit derivations from general matching moment formulas have not been excluded.
title: A triangle fingerprint in the third cumulants of random matching color profiles
